title: DepEd: New public schools must be PWD-accessible, disaster-resilient

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — New building standards issued by Education Secretary Sonny Angara require new public schools to be disaster-resilient and accessible to persons with disabilities (PWDs), among other things. The new requirements are set in DepEd Order No. 022, s. 2026, which establishes the Enhanced Minimum Performance Standards and Specifications (MPSS) for public basic education facilities. The order, which takes effect starting in fiscal year 2027, updates 2017 and 2021 guidelines and serves as the technical reference pursuant to applicable DepEd policies, laws, codes, and procurement laws for all new school infrastructure and furniture procurement.
